$comment: Contract of the SettingsPage and IssueBoardPage screens, 1:1 with each page's Prototype section: the 1440 desktop build shown in DocWindow at 0.75 and the 390 mobile build; below breakpoint.md (768) a screen draws its mobile build. Each screen is composed from components only and keeps its own pieces. The prototype (prototype.tsx) walks the sitemap (sitemap.ts) shown in DocWindow's address pill. Figma owns the anatomy, Storybook the behaviour.

blocks.name: SettingsPage
a11y: One main landmark; each SettingsSection is a section named by its h2 title
Each row's control is named by the row's title and described by its description
The current section's sidebar item carries aria-current=page
On a phone the select and segmented rows stack, so the control never leaves its label

blocks.name: IssueBoardPage
a11y: One main landmark; the filters are a search region and the board a named region
Each BoardColumn is a section named by its title and count; each IssueCard is one link named by its title
The lanes scroll sideways when they do not fit, without hiding a lane; on a phone they snap one lane at a time
